pair_status_at_frozen_snapshot.rule: Do not publish as downstream-eligible until a bootstrap-valid schema-3 C24 final novelty/relevance pair exists and each evidence tuple is mechanically confirmed as an exact member of its persisted raw three-field manifest. No fuzzy or semantic alias joining.

assessments.title: Persistent verifier metadata across the memory lifecycle
assessments.evidence_strength: Strong matched-control evidence within the reported agent-memory setting. MemGuard compares a verifier-only admission control against lifecycle-persistent verifier metadata under matched task order, step budget, retrieval budget and decoding settings; the verifier-only control underperforms full MemGuard in all 16 backbone-by-benchmark cells, averaged over five seeds.
assessments.scope_guard: Supports the incremental value of persisting verifier-derived governance metadata beyond one-time admission in the four named benchmarks/backbones. Does not prove robustness to malicious or systematically corrupted verifiers, forged metadata, arbitrary environment drift, or all memory architectures.
assessments.replication_status: author-reported multi-seed evaluation with public code; no independent numerical replication confirmed in this run

assessments.title: Terminating API routers break end-to-end command integrity
assessments.evidence_strength: Direct attack/defense evaluation supports the boundary claim: a plaintext-access terminating router can rewrite or exfiltrate agent interactions, while AEGIS moves plaintext handling into a client-attested enclave and blocks all four tested malicious-router classes, including adaptive tests against the same boundary. The source also reports a small 851-line trusted path and about 6 ms local relay overhead.
assessments.scope_guard: Supports the tested router threat model and attested faithful-passthrough construction. It does not establish universal TEE/platform security, eliminate metadata side channels, or prove provider-signed provenance is the only alternative.
assessments.replication_status: author evaluation; no independent numerical replication confirmed in this run

assessments.title: Read-side secret confinement and write-side effect authorization are distinct controls
assessments.evidence_strength: The common-harness results strongly support the practical value of SecureClaw's dual-boundary design across AgentDojo, AgentLeak and Agent Security Bench, including reported 0% ASR on ASB, 0.64% ASR on AgentDojo and 3.23% attacked-parity leakage on AgentLeak. However, the broader necessity claim that both boundaries are separately required is partly architectural reasoning rather than a complete factorial ablation of read-only versus write-only controls under every benchmark.
assessments.scope_guard: Do not upgrade the benchmark result into a universal confidentiality or authorization theorem. The trusted gateway/executor assumptions remain load-bearing and residual leakage is nonzero on AgentLeak.
assessments.replication_status: author common-harness evaluation; no independent numerical replication confirmed in this run

assessments.title: Event-sourced hypothesis/evidence/belief lifecycle with evidence-gated belief mutation
assessments.evidence_strength: HEP provides a direct same-goal/same-tools/same-base-LLM process comparison against a planning-style agent (n=3 per condition). The planning agent spends 83% of loop steps on tests and 0% on explicit belief updates, while HEP exhibits explicit H→T→E→B→J→U cycling and enforces append-only hypothesis identity, evidence-gated belief changes and lifecycle thresholds. Across three materials tasks, all hypotheses reach terminal states; base-model scaling is also measured under identical prompts/tools/stopping conditions.
assessments.scope_guard: Strong evidence for auditable process control and externalized belief-update behavior, not for superior final scientific correctness. Beliefs are elicited rather than statistically computed, the same agent validates much computational evidence, n is small for the matched process comparison, and the science fidelity is a fixed MLIP rather than independent experimental truth.
assessments.replication_status: author experiment; no independent numerical replication confirmed in this run

assessments.title: Monotone Shapley worst-case completion as an exact maximum-closure problem
assessments.evidence_strength: The two structural ingredients are externally well-supported: vertices of an order polytope are characteristic functions of filters/upper sets, and maximum-weight closure reduces to min-cut/max-flow. The worker's formulation then gives a plausible exact optimization route for worst-case monotone Shapley completion, with exact-integer coefficient scaling and eight LP cross-checks matching to <7e-16.
assessments.scope_guard: The general mathematical ingredients are established, but this exact Shapley reduction/implementation was derived and tested worker-locally rather than independently published or externally reproduced. Complexity remains exponential in n because the Boolean lattice has 2^n vertices.
assessments.replication_status: worker-local derivation plus local LP spot checks; no independent implementation replication confirmed

assessments.title: Preregistered unseen-seed holdout for deterministic monotone-completion certification
assessments.evidence_strength: A durable preregistration froze the same game, unseen seed set 1000..1999, budgets, thresholds and deterministic certifier before the holdout. Across 1000 unseen seeds there were zero solver failures and zero false certifications; at 896 oracle calls the rare-player phi<=0.005 certification rate was about 62% for each rare player, while exact completion certifies 100% at 1024 calls. This is meaningful confirmatory evidence that trusted monotonicity can materially tighten decision bounds on the fixed game.
assessments.scope_guard: Confirmatory only across unseen sampling seeds on one fixed synthetic game; not independent-game generalization, not proof of scalability, and safety is conditional on exact oracle values plus true monotonicity.
assessments.replication_status: worker-local preregistered holdout; no independent numerical replication confirmed
